title: Overconfidence, Under-Reaction, and Warren Buffett’s Investments
summary: RGA Investment Advisors runs a long-term, low turnover, growth at a reasonable price investment strategy seeking out global opportunities. Nice Pearl to not be afraid to sell if risk assessment and conviction changes, regardless of holding period!
